*/

 RET NUMBER;
 --P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN 
/*

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL (V_PRINT NUMBER)IS
 RET NUMBER ;
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5); 
 P_PORT VARCHAR2(200);

BEGIN 


------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
SELECT 1
 FROM declarations d,
 dcltn_items di,
 exmtn_decrees ed
 WHERE ( (d.port_cd = di.port_cd)
 AND (d.dcltn_isn = di.dcltn_isn)
 AND (ed.decree_port_cd = di.exmtn_decree_port_cd)
 AND (ed.decree_isn = di.exmtn_decree_isn)
 )
AND (:DECREE_TYPE IS NULL OR DECREE_TYPE = :DECREE_TYPE)
AND (:IMP_IMPR_NBR IS NULL OR D.IMPR_NBR = :IMP_IMPR_NBR)
AND ((:START_DT IS NULL AND :END_DT IS NULL) OR dcltn_DT BETWEEN :START_DT AND :END_DT )
AND (:P_PORT_CD IS NULL OR D.PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD) 
AND (:DECREE_ISN IS NULL OR DECREE_ISN = :DECREE_ISN)
); 

 V_COUNT := 1;
IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF V_PRINT = 1 THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN');
 END IF;
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DECREE_ISN ',TEXT_PARAMETER,:DECREE_ISN );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_IMPR_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER, :IMP_IMPR_NBR);

 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DECREE_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER, :DECREE_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CURR_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_CURR_PORT_CD);

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL; 
END ;
